**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require authorization before executing XLSX imports**

Any caller who can reach this Hono app can set the static `x-confirm-import: yes` header and trigger `executeXlsxImport` against the `owner`/`repo` query params with the server's GitHub credentials; unlike the webhook and coding-task routes, there is no signature, bearer token, session, or persona check before the write path. This turns the new endpoint into an unauthenticated GitHub write primitive, so add a real authorization boundary before accepting the confirmation header.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Drop the unsupported Milestone fragment from project item query**

When `GITHUB_PROJECT_NODE_ID` is configured, the snapshot reconcile task uses this query and `graphql()` throws on any returned GraphQL errors. GitHub's GraphQL Projects docs list `ProjectV2ItemContent` possible types as draft issues, issues, and pull requests, so the `... on Milestone` spread is invalid for this union and will make every reconcile page fail before snapshots are stored.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Encode project field values according to field_type**

When an import row targets a non-text Project v2 field such as Status/single-select, number, date, or iteration, this mutation still sends `value: { text: $value }` and never uses `input.fieldType`. GitHub's `ProjectV2FieldValue` input uses distinct keys such as `singleSelectOptionId`, `number`, `date`, `iterationId`, or `text`, so those valid spreadsheet rows fail during execute and are counted as failed instead of being imported.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
